status: proposal (not yet read by the build)
question: own no-war bands for purchases from Russia (to_rus) of the uncertain countries, by the cf_bands.json B2 rule unchanged
units: multipliers in real terms, as cf_bands.json: cumulative_band = multiplier on the SUM over the horizon of the central expected level (H5_2026_8of12 = 2022-2026 with 2026 at 8/12); multiplier_vs_2021 = per-year ratio to the yearly central; band_as_built = site/data.json to_rus.cb[5] (generic x 0.81)
rule: (unchanged) used only if (1) the 2022-2026 cumulative band is at least 10% narrower than the band the site builds now (generic x CB_SCALE_PAID 0.81), (2) leave-window-out coverage >= 80% (12/15: test origins 2007, 2012, 2016, training without any overlapping window), (3) out of time >= 80% (trained on errors ending by 2013, scored on origins 2014-2020, 25 errors), (4) >= 90% of the country's own 5-year windows inside (fuel_volume_cf.json safeguard, as Türkiye in round 43). Checks (2)-(4) must hold on series A and, where the country reports to the IMF, also on series B (B has no 2007 test window). At least 15 usable years of A.
how_to_apply: for each accepted ISO copy proposed_cf_bands_entry['countries.<ISO>.to_rus'] into cf_bands.json countries.<ISO>.to_rus; counterfactual() then replaces the generic multipliers and cumulative band and does not apply CB_SCALE_PAID (as Türkiye, round 43)
